# f5xc_role (Resource)

Defines the role the user has in a namespace. There are two kinds of roles:<br>* user defines roles - each tenant can define a set of their roles suiting their needs.<br>* built-in roles - volterra defined roles. Admins are free to use them but can't amend them nor can they remove them.

To get more information about f5xc_role, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/role)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Role - Basic

resource "f5xc_role" "example" {
  name       = "example-role"
  namespace  = "system"
  api_groups = ["ves-io-web-access-read"]
}
```
